title: Maize DNA Extraction and Sequencing
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH SERVICE.USDA ARS AFM APD
description_text: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1232SA26Q0568 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for DNA Extraction and Sequencing services for 384 maize leaf samples. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 541380 – Testing Laboratories and Services The small business size standard is $19,000,000 This acquisition is Choose an item. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency.
